item.text: {"case_id":"SHC045","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C15","C09"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 is the immediately preceding Florida energy-emergency extension and supplies nearly the entire concrete drafting structure of the child: the Governor-request predicate, extension of an earlier determination for thirty days, incorporation of the original conditions, rescission and termination of gubernatorial suspension orders if the emergency ends, preservation of EPA authority under Section 303, and the warning about Section 110(f)'s 120-day limit. C15 is also closely related but is the original determination rather than the more directly reused extension template. C09 shares an extension-determination form but lacks the distinctive Florida and Clean Air Act machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Based on a request submitted to me by the Governor of the State of Florida to extend my May 5, 1979 determination that a regional energy emergency continues to exist in the State of Florida ...
